class: TypeScript type error after a refactor
commitMessage: Rename User.name to displayName and return undefined for unknown users

expect.logRegex: error TS2339: Property 'name' does not exist on type 'User'

decoys.note: Asserts the user exists; an unknown id throws in the holdout.
Turns strict off to silence the undefined check.

notes: The 2.0 refactor renamed User.name to displayName and made findUser return undefined; format.ts still reads user.name. The fix uses displayName and greets an unknown id as a guest, per the JSDoc.
